injection_details.fallback: If explorer.exe not found, injects into own process (GetCurrentProcessId)
injection_details.method: Remote PE injection (RunPE-style without hollowing): OpenProcess(0x43A = PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_VM_READ|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION) -> VirtualAllocEx(NULL, SizeOfImage, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory of PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) and each section (raw data mapped to remoteBase+VirtualAddress) -> manual base relocation of IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 entries using ReadProcessMemory/NtWriteVirtualMemory with delta = remoteBase - ImageBase -> CreateRemoteThread(start = remoteBase + AddressOfEntryPoint, lpParameter = remoteBase)
injection_details.payload_source: 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob in .data at VA 0x140004000, decrypted in memory with key 'R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_K' before injection; injector validates MZ/PE magic and maps it as a PE image
